claims.text:
Your 0.3 cutoff kept A,C because A suppressed B at IoU 1/3. Raising the cutoff to 0.5 retained all three; equality at 1/3 also retained B under strict greater-than. Ranking and threshold convention matter. Suppression does not prove two boxes depict the same physical object.
